question: In which of following satyagraha's did Vallabh Bhai Patel get the title “Sardar”?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bardoli**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel was given the title of ‘Sardar’ during the Bardoli satyagraha (1928) by women.**
 
• **He was a social leader who pl**ayed a leading role in the country's struggle for independence and guided its integration into a united, independent nation.
 
• In India and elsewhere, he was often addressed as Sardar.
 
• The movement was initiated to protest against the **unjust increase in land revenue** by 22% imposed by the British government.
 
• **Vallabhbhai Patel led the peasants in non-violent resistance **against the increased taxes, encouraging them to refuse to pay the inflated taxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Champaran Satyagraha (1917)**

 
 
• The movement was initiated to address the plight of indigo farmers in Champaran, Bihar,
 
 
• who were forced by British planters to grow indigo under the oppressive **Tinkathia system** (compulsory cultivation on 3/20th of the land).
 
 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi led the movement after being approached by local farmers. It was his first major involvement in India's freedom struggle.
 
• Champaran marked the first practical application of **Gandhi’s Satyagraha**
 
 
 
• **​Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918)**
 
 
• Workers at the **cotton mills in Ahmedabad **were demanding better wages due to rising inflation, while mill owners were unwilling to give a fair wage increase
 
• The dispute centered around the demand for a **35% wage hike**.
 
• **Gandhi intervened and advised t**he workers to go on a peaceful strike.
 
• He also went on a hunger strike to strengthen the workers’ resolve.
 
 
 
• **Kheda Satyagraha (1918)**
 
 
• Farmers in Kheda district, Gujarat, were suffering due to crop failure and famine, yet the British government insisted on collecting full land revenue. 
 
• Led by **Mahatma Gandhi**, with support from **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**,
 
 
• this movement saw widespread participation from farmers who refused to pay taxes
 
 
 
• The Kheda Satyagraha further demonstrated the effectiveness of **nonviolent resistance**
